'''Kasper''' is a male NPC that can found in [[Fool's Elysium]]. He's a Firework Master of the [[Troupe of Fools]].

<!-- ==Quests and Events==
''(Not in any quest or event yet)''
{{Quests and Events}}-->


==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(In [[Fool's Elysium]])
:;'''Kasper''' What kind of fireworks display would fit the grand spectacle of Ragunna's Carnevale?
:;'''Kasper''' Fireworks shouldn't just light up the night... they need to dazzle in the daylight too!
:;'''Kasper''' I've got it! I've got it!
:;'''Kasper''' [[Golden Fleece]], a touch of unstable glazed young rock, and a feather from Pan Cake! I'll get consent first, I promise!
:;'''Kasper''' After that, three happy Nimbus Wraiths. I'll use their laughter to catalyze a rainbow of flame.
:;'''Kasper''' Then, the grand finale―Boom! My power will set it all off!

:'''Kasper:''' Golden Fleece, burst forth in colorful flames! Wait, that's strange...
:{{DIcon}} What are you up to?
:'''Kasper:''' I'm Kasper, the troupe's Fireworks Master. I'm experimenting with this Golden Fleece, you see.
:'''Kasper:''' It comes from the sighs of ancient dragons, the remnants of their flames. It was once used to make gunpowder.
:'''Kasper:''' But now, it will be transformed into the finest firework material!
:'''Kasper:''' No longer will it bring terror, but joy and laughter instead.
:'''Kasper:''' It will explode in the sky, lighting up Ragunna's sky!
:'''Kasper:''' But... there's still something missing... What could it be? Let me think a moment.
----
;(Ragunna City after [[What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing]])
:;'''Grahnom''' Woah—fireworks in daylight!
:;'''Mel''' Are those fireworks or contrails?
:;'''Kasper''' Heh, heh, these aren't just fireworks. This s "Cloudflame," a special concoction from the Golden Fleece!
:;'''Kasper''' —Brought to you by Kasper from the Fool's Troupe!

:'''Kasper''': Only such a spectacle is worthy of the Montellis! Feast your eyes!
:'''Grahnom''': Speaking of which... my father's birthday banquet is next month. Will you be available?
:'''Mel''': Me too, me too! I'm having my wedding next month! I want "Cloudflame" too!
:'''Kasper''': Woah, one at a time...
:'''Kasper''': Back when I did business in Ragunna... I don't remember being this popular.
:'''Grahnom''': Back then?
:'''Kasper''': Ahaha, I mean... it's great that everyone in Ragunna loves "Cloudflame"!
----
;(In Septimont at Daytime)
:'''Kasper''': So you're saying, you want to add a dash of panache to your team before the match starts?
:'''Kase''': Right. We want some of that... cheerful flair your troupe is famous for!
:'''Kase''': Our initial idea was to tie fireworks to the back of each Gladiator. That way, when they walk into the arena, the fireworks will shoot off and make everyone cheer for them!
:'''Kase''': Not bad, eh? See, your troupe isn't the only one with a flair for the dramatic!
:'''Kasper:''' Well... If I may be so bold, sir, does your team have a captain of the ship?
:'''Kase''': What? Captain of the ship? Oh, right, me. I'm the team captain!
:'''Kasper:''' Then I would sincerely recommend an alternative! Take a look. Our captain designed it. It can achieve your desired effect while ensuring that everyone stays safe!
:'''Kase''': Excellent... Although, can we tie a firework to their backs?

;(In Septimont at Nighttime)
:;'''Kasper:''' Hey... What kind of person did you get me? Is he really one of the Blue Furies?
:;'''Kasper:''' He had the nerve to reject my genius plan, which was more inspirational than the [[Iuno|priestess']] prophecies!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Notes==
*Pan Cake is the Fae Ignis that appears in Brant Companion Story: [[Sail Day, Captain!]]
*There is another [[Kasper (Septimontian)|Kasper]] from Septimont
